import 'dart:async';
import 'dart:io';
import 'dart:typed_data';

import 'package:adele_capabilities/adele_capabilities.dart';
import 'package:adele_environment/adele_environment.dart';
import 'package:adele_product/adele_product.dart';

import 'prepared_environment_capability_support.dart';

// Independent A owns its repositories and all OS access. It has no Git backend
// dependency, semantic Diff contract, or access to B's implementation.
Future<void> main(List<String> arguments, Object? bootstrapMessage) =>
    runProbeBackend(
      arguments,
      bootstrapMessage,
      (state) => {
        for (final id in ['a', 'b'])
          id: {
            environmentProviderServiceId: EnvironmentProviderServiceDispatcher(
              EnvironmentProviderServiceAdapter(
                id == 'a' && state.options['noBufferedFacet'] == true
                    ? _Environment(state, id)
                    : _BufferedEnvironment(state, id),
              ),
              concurrent: true,
            ),
          },
      },
    );

class _Environment implements EnvironmentProvider {
  _Environment(this.state, this.id);
  final ProbeState state;
  final String id;
  final roots = <String, String>{};

  @override
  ProviderId get providerId => ProviderId('test.environment.$id');

  @override
  Future<EnvironmentProviderResult> restore(
    LocalEnvironment environment,
  ) async {
    final expected = id == 'a' ? 'additional' : 'primary';
    final root = (state.options['roots'] as Map)[expected] as String;
    if (environment.id.value != expected ||
        environment.providerState!['root'] != root ||
        await Directory(root).resolveSymbolicLinks() != root) {
      throw StateError('Environment does not belong to this fixture provider.');
    }
    roots[expected] = root;
    return EnvironmentProviderResult(providerState: environment.providerState!);
  }

  @override
  dynamic noSuchMethod(Invocation invocation) => throw UnsupportedError(
    'Only restore and buffered processes are provided.',
  );
}

final class _BufferedEnvironment extends _Environment
    implements EnvironmentBufferedProcessProvider {
  _BufferedEnvironment(super.state, super.id);

  @override
  Future<EnvironmentBufferedProcessResult> runBufferedProcess(
    EnvironmentId environmentId,
    EnvironmentBufferedProcessRequest request,
  ) async {
    final root = roots[environmentId.value];
    if (root == null || request.relativeWorkingDirectory != '') {
      throw StateError('Only the exact restored Environment root is allowed.');
    }
    if (!const {
      '/bin/sh',
      '/usr/bin/git',
      '/usr/bin/stat',
      '/usr/bin/head',
      '/bin/pwd',
    }.contains(request.program)) {
      throw StateError('Unexpected executable in the portable Linux profile.');
    }
    if (id == 'a' && state.options['unavailable'] == true) {
      throw const EnvironmentFailure(
        code: environmentBufferedProcessUnavailableCode,
        message: 'Independent provider explicitly unavailable.',
        details: {},
      );
    }
    final evidence = <String, Object?>{
      'environmentId': environmentId.value,
      'providerId': providerId.value,
      'cwd': root,
      'program': request.program,
      'arguments': request.arguments,
      'stdinBase64': request.stdinBase64,
    };
    state.processes.add(evidence);
    final process = await Process.start(
      request.program,
      request.arguments,
      workingDirectory: root,
      includeParentEnvironment: false,
      environment: const {'PATH': '/usr/bin:/bin', 'LC_ALL': 'C'},
    );
    final stdout = BytesBuilder(copy: false);
    final stderr = BytesBuilder(copy: false);
    final subscriptions = <StreamSubscription<List<int>>>[];
    Future<void> capture(
      Stream<List<int>> stream,
      BytesBuilder bytes,
      int limit,
    ) {
      final done = Completer<void>();
      subscriptions.add(
        stream.listen(
          (chunk) {
            if (done.isCompleted) return;
            if (bytes.length + chunk.length > limit) {
              done.completeError(
                const EnvironmentFailure(
                  code: 'process_output_overflow',
                  message: 'Independent fixture output bound exceeded.',
                  details: {},
                ),
              );
            } else {
              bytes.add(chunk);
            }
          },
          onDone: () {
            if (!done.isCompleted) done.complete();
          },
          onError: (Object error, StackTrace trace) {
            if (!done.isCompleted) done.completeError(error, trace);
          },
        ),
      );
      return done.future;
    }

    Future<void> input() async {
      process.stdin.add(
        decodeEnvironmentProcessBytes(
          request.stdinBase64,
          maximumBytes: environmentBufferedProcessStdinLimit,
        ),
      );
      await process.stdin.close();
    }

    try {
      final results = await Future.wait<Object?>([
        process.exitCode,
        capture(process.stdout, stdout, environmentBufferedProcessStdoutLimit),
        capture(process.stderr, stderr, environmentBufferedProcessStderrLimit),
        input(),
      ], eagerError: true).timeout(Duration(seconds: request.timeoutSeconds));
      final exitCode = results.first! as int;
      evidence['exitCode'] = exitCode;
      // Hold an actual completed child result, not synthetic process output.
      await state.checkpoint('process:completed');
      return EnvironmentBufferedProcessResult(
        exitCode: exitCode,
        stdoutBase64: encodeEnvironmentProcessBytes(
          stdout.takeBytes(),
          maximumBytes: environmentBufferedProcessStdoutLimit,
        ),
        stderrBase64: encodeEnvironmentProcessBytes(
          stderr.takeBytes(),
          maximumBytes: environmentBufferedProcessStderrLimit,
        ),
      );
    } on TimeoutException {
      throw const EnvironmentFailure(
        code: 'process_timed_out',
        message: 'Independent fixture process deadline exceeded.',
        details: {},
      );
    } finally {
      process.kill(ProcessSignal.sigkill);
      await Future.wait(
        subscriptions.map((subscription) => subscription.cancel()),
      );
      await process.exitCode.timeout(const Duration(seconds: 1));
    }
  }
}
